findings.title: Per-client resources bypass all-clients permissions
findings.body: When a client-specific resource already exists, this evaluates only that resource and never checks the `Clients` resource used for all-clients grants. Such resources can be created by a permission for any scope on that client; afterward, an administrator granted `manage`, `view`, or another scope on all clients can be denied access to that client. Evaluate the all-clients resource as an additional fallback even when the client-specific resource exists.
